persons.name: Rājamānasiṃha
persons.evidence: dānapati jajomāna nyapāramaṇḍale kāstapamaṇḍale kṛrttipunyavajradhātucaityamahāvihārayā śākyabhikṣu rājamānasiṃha jajomānayā ... thugurī puṣṭaka thao nitye 2 svādhyārtha yāyasta dayakāo tayā jura

relations.evidence: likhita tetavāhārayā śrīvajrācārya, sarvānandraneti ... dānapati jajomāna ... rājamānasiṃha

purpose: thao nitye 2 svādhyārtha yāyasta (for his own daily recitation/study)
notes: The commissioner Rājamānasiṃha, a Śākyabhikṣu from Kīrtipuṇyavajradhātucaityamahāvihāra in Kathmandu, commissioned the manuscript for daily recitation while staying in Lhasa (Hlāsadeśa) engaged in trade. The scribe Sarvānanda Vajrācārya belongs to Te Bahal (Tetavāhāra) in Kathmandu.
